subject: Hosted inference — gradual latency increase (US-WEST) — customer advisory
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Atlas Health <ops@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 08:03:12 -0700
Subject: Hosted inference — gradual latency increase (US-WEST) — customer advisory

Hi Sara / Atlas ops team,

We’re reaching out to let you know we are investigating a gradual increase in request P95 and streaming tail latency for hosted inference in the US-WEST region that started between 07:40–07:55 PDT. Some customers (including a small subset of Atlas Health traffic) may see delayed chunking and occasional partial responses for long streaming requests.

What we know so far:
- Start: ~07:40 PDT; observed as elevated P95 for generation and longer streaming chunk intervals.
- Scope: Affects hosted inference in US-WEST; not all routes/models are impacted.
- Immediate mitigation: We have enabled temporary routing to healthy pools for eligible requests and increased prefetch windows where safe.
- Impact: Increased latency (P95) and sporadic streaming elongation; no data loss or incorrect responses identified.

Actions we’re taking and next steps:
1) Priority triage (in progress) — engineering on the bridge to identify root cause and implement a targeted remediation.
2) Short-term routing — continuing to route eligible traffic away from saturated pools; you may see requests served from us-east for a small percentage.
3) Ongoing updates every ~60 minutes or sooner if we have material changes.

We’ve attached a preliminary incident timeline and a small log excerpt to help your engineers correlate any customer-side errors. We’ll provide a follow-up with ETA for full resolution or the next mitigation within the hour.

We apologize for the disruption — we know reliability is critical. Please reply here if you need a dedicated phone bridge or contact method; Karthik and Sean are on the thread for escalation.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Reliability Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 08:21:49 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted inference — gradual latency increase (US-WEST) — customer advisory

Thanks for the quick heads-up, Hannah.

We started seeing increased response times around 07:50; for us the most visible impact is longer confirmation dialogs in our UI (3–7s spikes on P95). Our on-call is monitoring. Can you confirm:
- Is there an ETA for full mitigation?
- Can you route all our traffic to another region temporarily (we can accept the small cross-region latency increase)?

Also please escalate to account execs — our CTO is monitoring and may request a brief call if the issue persists.

Appreciate the attachments — I’ll share with our on-call.

—Sara
Sara Li
Site Reliability Engineer | Atlas Health
ops@atlashealth.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Atlas Health <ops@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 09:07:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted inference — gradual latency increase (US-WEST) — customer advisory

Sara — thanks for the details.

Update (09:07 PDT):
- Our bridge team has identified a surge in background prefetch fanout combined with a suboptimal kernel path on a small set of GPU pools that increased tail latency for longer sequences.
- We’ve applied an emergency kernel selection patch to the affected pool and are progressively shifting Atlas Health traffic off the impacted hosts where routing rules allow.
- Per your ask, we can enable full-region reroute for Atlas Health: we estimate ~2–3 minutes to enable and validate. If you want us to proceed, reply with confirmation and we’ll perform the switch.

Temporary mitigations completed so far:
- Emergency kernel patch (partial rollout)
- Increased routing bias to healthy pools and expanded prefetch allowance where safe
- Telemetry dashboards updated to show per-pool health (link in related_links)

We’ll keep you updated at 10:00 PDT or sooner. If you prefer a short bridge now, I can spin one up with Sean and Karthik.

Hannah
Senior Customer Reliability Manager | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 12:47:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted inference — gradual latency increase (US-WEST) — customer advisory

Hi team — quick summary and next steps from our side:

Summary:
- Root cause appears to be a combination of prefetch amplification and a narrow kernel path on a subset of GPU hosts in US-WEST. Patch has been applied and routing changes are in flight.
- Atlas Health: routing bias has been moved; we have not yet enabled full-region reroute per your preference.

Next steps:
1) We will continue monitoring: another update at 13:30 PDT and again at 16:00 PDT if the issue persists.
2) Postmortem: scheduling a 30-minute review with Atlas Health engineers and Redwood infra on Monday 2025-10-13 at 10:00 PDT. Invite will follow.
3) Deliverables: timeline, root cause analysis, mitigations, and long-term checks to prevent prefetch amplification.

If Atlas wants immediate region reroute, we can do that now — Hannah will coordinate. Sean will join the postmortem and be the exec contact.

Thanks for your patience — we’ll share the postmortem doc link once the first draft is ready.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
